input.prompt:
Propose one experimentally testable VH/VL redesign for B7-H3 Arm B
parent 131, for a Y-shaped humanized IgG with separate HC and LC.
Use only the reference evidence below at its stated strength. Preserve the arm's
intended epitope and complete variable-domain framework. Treat reference-chain
and internal-coverage uncertainties explicitly. If evidence is insufficient for
a warranted sequence change, return a review_required result with the reason.
Return JSON with parent_id, arm, status, vh, vl, changes, rationale and uncertainties.
Do not use tools or read other files. The final Fc and pairing architecture are
outside this proposal. Do not represent predicted binding as measured.
Use the verified RFantibody design-loop positions to distinguish design loops
from framework. The AF3 contacts are model observations. Propose at most two
loop substitutions as hypotheses when supported by the parent evidence, with
explicit residue-level rationale. Preserve framework residues and sequence
lengths. If the input poses are insufficient, record why.

proposal.rationale: The supplied AF3 poses do not support a specific loop substitution for the intended IgC1 Q228–R241 patch. VL F90 in the verified L3 loop is the only design-loop residue reported to contact the same target residue across two poses, contacting canonical residue 229 at 2.85 and 4.11 Å. Those minimum distances do not establish the interacting atoms or provide a reason to replace F90. The 20G5 structures support Q228 as a site of interest, with reported distances of 3.001 Å in 9LY5 and 5.169 Å in 9LY6, but provide no parent-specific substitution rationale. The returned sequences are the complete parent variable domains for separate heavy and light chains, with all residues and lengths preserved.
uncertainties: Reference-chain assignment and footprint transfer remain unresolved. The deposited 20G5 Fab complexes and patent-disclosed Hz20G5.26 HC 35 and LC 36 describe different constructs. The exact 24F chain and constant-region variant also requires reconciliation. The reported 0.80 nM binding of 24F-Hu-WT to 4Ig supports its whole-IgG comparator role while leaving exact patch overlap unresolved. The other references provide neighboring-site, domain-level, or competition-bin evidence without a residue-level substitution rationale for parent 131.

Internal coverage is limited to four reported AF3 samples from two seeds and a 4.5 Å contact cutoff. One sample reports no contacts, one reports Q228 contacts exclusively outside the verified design loops at VL P56 and R58, and the other two place Q228 near different loop residues. No contacts are listed for canonical positions 233–241.

The 1.64 Å minimum distance between VH K100 and Q228 warrants coordinate inspection for a possible clash. The supplied lists lack atom identities and pose-quality metrics needed to interpret that distance or select a mutation. Parent binding and epitope occupancy on native 4Ig are unverified experimentally in the supplied record.
